description: The header's permission-mode drop-down: a plain list of the modes the chat's program offers, a tick on the current one, opened centred under its button.

parts.name: Claude's modes, in order
parts.shows: Six rows for Claude's models: Manual (value default), Accept edits, Plan, Auto, Don't ask, Bypass permissions. A new chat starts on Auto.

actions.does: Switches the chat's permission mode (asked of claude; on success the quiet note "permission mode → <label>"). If claude refuses (for example Bypass when the chat wasn't started able to bypass), the picker returns to the mode it is still in and the chat notes "couldn't switch to <mode>: <why> (still <was>)" (or without the "still" part with no known earlier mode)

parts.name: Codex modes
parts.shows: Three rows for a Codex model: Manual, Auto, Bypass Permissions. A Codex chat starts on Manual.

states.name: hidden
states.shows: Not shown for models whose program has no permission modes, unless the chat's host offers set_permission_mode
